overview: Billing questions dominate telco contact centres, and they are the least productive calls a centre takes: a subscriber who cannot see why a charge appeared calls to ask, waits, and often calls again. The AI Care Copilot parses the bill line by line, answers the question in the subscriber's own words with the rate-plan clause and the charge it came from, and either resolves it in self-service or hands the agent the explanation already assembled. Answers are grounded in the operator's own billing records and policy base, never improvised. Four to five weeks on real bills and call drivers shows what handle time and containment actually do.
